import 'package:routed_auth/routed_auth.dart';
import 'package:routed_core/routed_core.dart';

void main() {
  final deployment = AuthDeployment<String>.custom(
    options: AuthOptions<String>(
      providers: const <AuthProvider>[],
      store: InMemoryAuthStore(),
      storeMode: AuthStoreMode.ephemeral,
    ),
    configuration: AuthConfig.defaults(),
    proxyPolicy: const AuthProxyPolicy.direct(),
  );
  final engine = Engine();

  deployment.bindTo(engine);
  deployment.serviceProvider();
  deployment.engineConfig();
}
